title: Twisted coordinate-section Kummer normalization at every finite level
statement:
Fix the finite datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All bases below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the specified pro-etale Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and adjunction-preserving composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate].

Let $p:X=\mathbf A^1_T\to T$ have zero section $s$, and compactify it by $j:X\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf P^1_T$, $q:P\to T$ [def-sbc-affine-space, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let $D_0\subset P$ be the zero-section divisor, with $\mathcal O_P(D_0)=\mathcal O_P(1)$ in the divisor-line-bundle convention [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Fix any $a\geq1$ killing $A$ by $\ell^a$, and set $L_U=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^a,U}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^a}A$. Write $c^e_{D_0,A}$ for the ordinary supported Kummer map [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer], $h:A_T\to Rq_*L_P[2]$ for the Kummer class of $\mathcal O_P(1)$, and $I_p:R p_!L_X[2]\to A_T$ for restriction of the trace [def-amb-p1-trace] by the open counit. Forgetting the support of $c^e_{D_0,A}$ gives $h$, and, with the identity-normalized source $Rp_!s_*A_T\cong A_T$,
$$I_p\circ Rp_!(c^e_{s(T),A})=t_qh=1_{A_T}.$$

On the pro-etale site let $c_{s,A}:s_*A_T\to A_X(1)[2]$ be [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map], and let $u_s:A_T\to Rs^!A_X(1)[2]$ be its exceptional adjunct. This is an isomorphism, and for the actual integration-transposed comparison $\gamma_{p,-}$ of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison] the composite
$$A_T\xrightarrow{u_s}Rs^!A_X(1)[2]\xrightarrow{Rs^!\gamma_{p,A_T}}Rs^!Rp^!A_T\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T$$
is the identity. All arrows, including this composition identification, are the transports of the ordinary etale arrows under [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]; the assertion is equality of derived morphisms. On the domain of [def-pur-affine-line-datum], $u_s=-\operatorname{pur}_s$, where $\operatorname{pur}_s$ is [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation], using the signed relative-cone and localization-boundary convention of [lem-pur-divisor-relative-cone]. Thus the positive Cartier-Chern normalization and the positive localization-boundary orientation differ by this sign.

For each $r\geq0$ put $M_r=A_T(r)[2r]$. Under the canonical closed co-projection isomorphism [lem-pur-immersion-twist], define
$$u_{s,M_r}=u_s\otimes1_{M_r}:M_r\longrightarrow Rs^!A_X(r+1)[2r+2].$$
It is an isomorphism, with supported adjoint the map $s_*M_r\cong s_*A_T\otimes p^*M_r\xrightarrow{c_{s,A}\otimes1}A_X(r+1)[2r+2]$ using the canonical proper projection map. The twisted identity is
$$\bigl(Rs^!Rp^!M_r\xrightarrow{\sim}M_r\bigr)\circ Rs^!(\gamma_{p,M_r})\circ u_{s,M_r}=1_{M_r}.$$
Its transpose is $1_{M_r}\otimes I_p(c^e_{s(T),A})$, with the tensor and shift identifications just specified. The maps are independent of $a$; neither flatness of $A$ over $\mathbf Z/\ell^a$ nor divisibility of $n$ by the ramification index is assumed.

proof.text: The affine line is smooth of relative dimension one. The closed zero section is canonically isomorphic to the subscheme of its kernel; the composite of that subscheme with the line projection is an isomorphism by the section equation. Apply the finite-flat relative Cartier criterion to obtain hI. Finite type over Spec k gives IsNoetherian T. The projective zero composite with the separated projective projection is identity, hence the projective zero section is closed. This proves the geometry directly, without choosing a vector-bundle presentation.

Apply coordinateSectionProjectiveTrace for ProjectiveNormalization and the positive projective Chern adjunct equation. Compose that equation with the actual projective trace; by the definition of CoordinateLine.integration this gives the second ordinary equation. projectiveLineTrace_chern gives the scalar identity, the third equation. Apply coordinateSectionTensorTrace to this scalar identity to obtain the closed coprojection formula and the remaining ordinary tensor and exceptional equations. Assemble OrdinaryNormalization.

Apply coordinateSectionSiteTransport for CartierRealization and, using the ordinary and coprojection conclusions, ProNormalization. For each exponent choose the invertibility witness from primeUnit.pow, rewriting Nat.cast_pow. Assemble NormalizationAt. Apply coordinateCartierBoundarySign for the negative orientation clause. Package all witnesses in the original existential and conjunction, retaining the instance-quantified Noetherian and closed-immersion clauses.

The delivery has no new nodes. No SGA is cited and nothing in the closure is dropped. STATEMENT CORRECTION ACCEPTED: '$u_s$ agrees with thm-pur-affine-line-orientation' became $u_s=-\mathrm{pur}_s$. Checked from statements: pur_s is the adjunct of $+\partial\kappa(t)$, where the support-sequence snake boundary equals $(0,-b)$ in the signed cone of lem-pur-divisor-relative-cone. The Cartier map $c^e$ is the Yoneda splice of def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary. With frame $e=t^{-1}$ and divisor section $\tau=te$, lem-pur-principal-torsor-yoneda-sign at $g=t$ gives $-\partial\delta(t)$. This matches lem-per-supported-yoneda-localization, lem-pur-cartier-relative-kummer-realization and lem-per-cartier-gysin-kummer-boundary, and the two signs differ whenever $2\ne0$ in $A$ (the F_3 example is correct). Nothing is weakened. FIX (C3/C4, Step 7): the step got the cone representative $(0,\delta(t))$ from no node ('applies the Kummer connecting map to the relative class') and used 'the construction in' lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map. I rewrote it to cite lem-pur-principal-torsor-yoneda-sign plus lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer, with the relative-cone node's coefficient and site clauses and lem-amb's etale-origin clause. The added node's closure (226 nodes) contains neither the item nor its parent, its unit sk-prop-a1-kummer is in sk-prop-an's uses, and it adds no batch-5 node. I removed lem-pur-support-comparison-boundary from Step 7, proof_deps and split_report.tool_uses. The report is right that citing lem-pur-cartier-relative-kummer-realization or lem-pur-line-zero-class-etale-realization would close a cycle. The other steps check out: 095L/03DJ open counit; identity-normalized $\sigma$ and $t_qh=1$; invertibility of $\gamma$ at every level from lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction, the open tensor adjunct, $\pi$ naturality and conjugation, with no $e\mid n$; site transport via vector-integration, closed-section-compact-origin, closed counit and compact-support coherence; the 0037/0DV0 counit identities; immersion-twist and coprojection mate; composition-projection-mate plus the projection formula, with sign $(-1)^{4r}=1$; exponent independence. Batch 5: oriented-closed-base-localization (Stacks 08LY closed subtopos), adjoint-composition-coherence (Mathlib leaf) and the pod 0DV5 lisse chain behind the finite projection formula are generic, so accepted. bounded-below-derived-adjunction is generic, and its citation is removed.
